learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn that words showing action or doing something are called Action Words or Verbs.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Can you jump like a frog? 🐸 Or fly like a bird? 🐦 Jumping and flying are things we DO! Today, let's learn about words that show action.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🏃 What are Action Words? (काम वाले शब्द)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words that tell us what a person, animal, or thing is doing are called Action Words. In grammar, they are called Verbs (क्रिया). If you can 'do' it, it is an action word!

lesson_modules.module_title: ☀️ Actions We Do Every Day (रोजमर्रा के काम)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: From the moment we wake up in the morning, we do many actions. These are all verbs!
Animals also do actions! A dog barks, a fish swims, and a monkey climbs. Bark, swim, and climb are action words too.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ What does a fish do in the water?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: I _____ with my legs.
subjective_practice.hint: What do you do with your legs to go to the park? (Walk / See)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline the action word in this sentence: 'Ravi plays football.'
✍️ Write one action word for something you do in the playground.
subjective_practice.hint: Do you jump, run, or swing?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Action Charades Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Act out three action words without speaking (like crying, laughing, or eating) and let your parents guess the correct Action Word!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Action words tell us what someone or something is doing.
⭐ Action words are also called Verbs.
⭐ Examples: Run, jump, eat, sleep, drink.
